title: Inheritance and Ledger
author: Cyrus Vasquez
blurb: Paloma Voss, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
